subject: Air freight quote: MUC to CAI
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option from MUC to CAI (Cairo, EG)? We’ll deliver the shipment to MUC ourselves, and it’ll be ready on 2026-11-27.

It’s 5 pieces of furniture samples, with a gross weight of 292 kg and a total volume of 2.78 cbm. Each piece measures 120 x 40 x 116 cm. I’ve attached our packing specification for reference.

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
